facts.text: John mentions that his teammates' belief in him and his love for improving his skills keep him motivated during challenging times.

evidence.quote: My teammates believing in me and my love for improving my skills keep me going, even when things get tough. I don't want to let them down.

facts.text: John states that his teammates always support him, even when he makes mistakes, and their encouragement keeps him going.

evidence.quote: They always support me, even when I make mistakes. Their encouragement keeps me going.

facts.text: John keeps a plaque on his desk that serves as a constant reminder to believe in himself and trust his abilities.

evidence.quote: This plaque I keep on my desk is a constant reminder to believe in myself. It helps me trust my abilities and face any obstacles.

facts.text: John acknowledges having a strong support network outside of sports, with people who are always there for him no matter what.

evidence.quote: Yeah, I'm lucky - I have people who are super supportive, always there for me no matter what.
